callees.name: _analysis_or_empty
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a non-empty string identifying the project root directory.
callees.post_condition: Returns an ELP analysis object whose .spans attribute is a dict mapping absolute file paths to lists of (func_name, start_idx, end_idx) tuples. Returns an object with an empty .spans dict when the ELP backend is unavailable or no analysis data exists for proj_dir.
